Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:35471
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6674 of 2023

Applicant :- Abhay Narayan @ Mulayam
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Prin.Secy. Deptt. Of Home And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Dheerendra Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Dheerendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Abhay Narayan alias Mulayam seeks bail in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 0632 OF 2022, under sections 363, 366, I.P.C., during investigation changed to sectioins 363/366/376, I.P.C. and section 3/4, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, P.S. Purwa, District Unnao.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a First Information Report (F.I.R.) lodged on 18.12.2022 stating that the applicant had enticed away the informant's minor daughter on 12.12.2022.
4.
In the statement of the victim recorded under section 161, Cr.P.C. she has stated that she has married the applicant out of her own freewill and she wants to live with him only.

sentences.text: In the medico-legal examination report of the victim, no external or internal injury has been reported on any part of her body.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under section 164, Cr.P.C. also she reiterated her earlier version.
7. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail-application, but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that the applicant and the victim both are persons of young age, who fell in love and married each other and in such circumstances it cannot reasonably be expected that the applicant positively knew that the applicant is minor, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
